mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp and PAYEMS increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures, which erodes real returns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP (GDPC1) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 1 quarter
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
